overview.allText: VEGANS EXPLORE GUIDES The Creator Guide Free WITH A SHORT SURVEY TAKE SURVEY Already a member?Sign in Overview The 10 tips (locked) People doing it Pulse (locked) Get access Become a creator FOR CONTENT CREATORS Looking for paid work that fits what you already make? Over the next few months we are bringing local businesses, national brands and events onto Vegans Explore in every one of our chapters, and their campaigns need creators. Register to be considered, and the opportunities that fit you come straight to your own Creator Dashboard. WHAT YOU GET Gigs delivered to you Paid campaigns, product collaborations, hosting and events, matched to your city, your topics and your audience. A media kit partners trust Your platforms, your best work and your results in one page, shown to a partner only once you are shortlisted. Paid fairly, on time Half your fee when you are booked, the other half when your posts are live. You set your rates. Room to rise Points gigs and gigs with no follower minimum let a small creator build a record. Results count more than followers. HOW IT WORKS 1 Apply to be considered Tell us who you are, where you post and what you make. 2 Get approved Our team reads every application and sets up your dashboard. 3 Gigs come to you Apply, audition or claim the ones you want. 4 Deliver and rise Get paid, and let your results open bigger gigs. HOW TO USE THIS PAGE Press Next, at the top or the bottom of any step, to walk through the Creator Dashboard as Kai sees it. Click around as you go. Apply to a gig or claim one: in this demo nothing is sent. When you are ready, the last step is the application. You can also jump straight to it. START THE WALKTHROUGH SKIP TO THE APPLICATION KAI Hi, I'm Kai. I make Vegan food and fitness videos in Miami, and this is my Creator Dashboard. Press Start the walkthrough and I'll show you around: the gigs, the ones I'm in, my media kit and how you rise. At the end, you can apply. ▶ PLAY KAI
